card.name: Pronouns in violent crime reports
card.fires_on: Pronouns, small linking words and verbs right after a violent act on a victim (beat, killed, drugged, kidnapped) in human-rights or crime news. It marks the spot where the sentence continues the story of the victim or body.

modes.label: Victim pronoun
modes.description: him or his right after a verb of violence or death.
modes.example: Alexandre Francisco Balate drugged, beat, and burned Abranches Afonso Penicelo and left<< him>> for dead

modes.label: Linking word in an abduction
modes.description: and or was continuing a sentence about someone taken or killed.
modes.example: pushed him into a vehicle<< and>> drove away

modes.label: Killing verb
modes.description: A verb of killing after shot and.
modes.example: police officer Siv Soeun allegedly shot and<< killed>> a person

card.plain: It lights up on small words in news accounts of beatings and killings, just after the violence is described.
